name: Elizabeth Lugo
title: Front-End Software Developer
summary: Front-end focused software developer with 5+ years of experience building web-based tools, internal applications, and data-driven interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and JSON. Combines development experience at Google and Intel with a growing freelance practice building JSON-driven, modular websites for small businesses, plus self-directed portfolio and author-site projects demonstrating responsive layout techniques (Flexbox, CSS Grid) and reusable, template-based architecture. Comfortable leveraging AI-assisted development workflows to accelerate builds, debug efficiently, and keep code clean and well-documented. Strong track record automating workflows, training and onboarding team members, and translating business requirements into functional, maintainable solutions.
